name: distribution_drift
hypothesis: A per-scope population stability index over the appended period, thresholded against the reference window's OWN measured week-to-week PSI distribution rather than a global constant, detects an invariant-preserving value redistribution that the deterministic evidence layer (structural fingerprint, attribution, reconciliation, lineage) cannot see.
why_this_gate: The deterministic layer keys on row count, null cells, duplicate keys, entity-set hash, metric sums and distinct counts. A redistribution that preserves all six changes the joint distribution while every registered key is unchanged. Temporal per-entity series may also stay inside their own materiality floors, because no single entity need move far. Neither mechanism is distribution-shaped.

design.signal: population stability index (PSI) of the target period's value distribution against a trailing reference window of the same scope and metric
design.threshold: derived per scope from the reference window's own consecutive-week PSI distribution: threshold = max(abs_floor, quantile(clean_week_psi, quantile_level)). Never a single global constant, because PSI's asymptotic distribution depends on bin count and both sample sizes.
design.held_constant: identical scenario suite, identical split, identical reference window length. Only the presence of the threshold and the drift statistic differ.

arms.engine_only: existing qc run status and latest_week anomaly set
arms.engine_plus_drift: the same run with the drift check enabled

acceptance.blind_fault_detection_rate: of injected invariant-preserving redistributions, the fraction the drift check flags while the engine-only arm does not
acceptance.control_alarm_rate: of unmodified scenarios, the fraction the drift check flags; must stay at or below max_control_alarm_rate or the check is a false-positive generator
acceptance.paired_separation: for every scenario, drift(control) < drift(fault); a scenario where the control scores at or above the fault fails the gate

claims_limit: Passing this gate authorises a `research` status on synthetic data only. It does not confer validated-real, does not authorise statistical clearance, and does not establish a production false-positive rate. Real-data qualification requires a real labelled cohort, as for every other milestone in docs/claims.md.
note: Written BEFORE any measurement of the drift check's behaviour. If the gate fails it is reported as failed and not retro-fitted, exactly as the B1 decomposition gate was.
